answer: Standing decays while an identity stays quiet, and one upheld challenge revokes it outright, with no appeal tier that restores it, only a fresh probation run. Quorum for any grading panel must span three unrelated subnetworks, so renting a wharf of cheap addresses on one host buys no votes. A farm's real cost is not registration but keeping every account active enough to survive decay while its ivory reputation sits one credible complaint from zero. Orchard-scale operations attract exactly that complaint.
